# The design system

> A math-driven CSS + React component library built for LLM-assisted development:
> 131 components, 12 page blocks, 3-tier tokens, and a check gate that
> rejects invented components, invented props, raw px/hex and wrong
> representations. This file is generated from the same registry the gate
> verifies — if a thing is not listed here, it does not exist.

## Hard rules

- Never invent a component, a prop or a variant value. The lists below are
  complete; a value outside a stated union is a defect.
- Components use semantic design tokens (var(--space-*), var(--font-*), roles
  like var(--primary)); a raw px or hex in component code fails the linter.
- No inline styles except truly dynamic values. No !important. Logical
  properties (padding-inline, text-align: start) — the system is RTL-ready.
- Page structure comes from the blocks (ListPageTemplate, DetailPageTemplate,
  AuthTemplate, WizardTemplate): a screen that hand-rolls its own width, centering
  or header is wrong.
- Icon-only controls take BOTH aria-label and a Tooltip wrapper.
- Every list, table and search has an empty state.
- One primary Button per visible surface: a screen answers once.
- Nothing here is missing on purpose. If a part genuinely does not exist, do not
  hand-roll it and do not hand-build its folder either: `npm run new -- Name
  --level … --surface … --category … --about "…"` writes every file and every
  registration a part needs, and `--remove` reverses them.

## Choosing a representation (the decision rules)

A zone is judged by the user's task and the shape of the data, not by taste:

- R1 Looking up and comparing records wants columns: Table/TreeTable/PivotTable/ComparisonTable/ScheduleGrid/DiffTable or DataGrid. Two adjacent data points in a column are compared without moving the eyes or holding values in working memory; cards force spatial reorientation per item and de-emphasize ranking (NN/g data tables, NN/g cards).
- R2 Editing at scale is a data grid: DataGrid. When cell-level editing is the primary task the surface is a data grid; a plain table carries occasional inline edits only (Smart Interface Design Patterns).
- R3 Scanning a few attributes wants rows: ListItem or Table/TreeTable/PivotTable/ComparisonTable/ScheduleGrid/DiffTable. With one to three attributes per item a linear list scans fastest; columns earn their chrome only when several fields are compared (uxpatterns.dev: start with list).
- R4 Judging candidates one by one wants tiles: Card/LinkTile/PlanCard or ListItem. Browsing has no single target: each item is read and judged on its own content, so it gets a self-contained surface. The moment the job becomes comparing fields across items, the task is compare and R1 applies (NN/g cards: browsing, not searching).
- R5 Monitoring wants preattentive values: Stat/Meter/Progress. A monitoring surface is read at a glance and acted on elsewhere: encode quantity with length and position (Stat, Meter), never with prose or rows (NN/g dashboards).
- R6 Analysis drills from aggregate to rows: Stat/Meter/Progress or Table/TreeTable/PivotTable/ComparisonTable/ScheduleGrid/DiffTable. Analysis is one investigation loop: the aggregate on top, the transactional rows under it, acted on where they are (SAP Fiori analytical list page).
- R7 Prose is never tabular: Card/LinkTile/PlanCard or ListItem. A collection of text-heavy items (questions, messages, findings) is read item by item; a table of paragraphs has columns that align nothing (NN/g data tables: tables are for discrete comparable values).
- R8 A queue is a worklist: Table/TreeTable/PivotTable/ComparisonTable/ScheduleGrid/DiffTable or ListItem. Working through items that each need a decision is a worklist: the set is given, so it needs density and status, not discovery chrome (SAP Fiori worklist = list report minus the filter bar).
- R10 A short queue reads as cards: Card/LinkTile/PlanCard or ListItem or Table/TreeTable/PivotTable/ComparisonTable/ScheduleGrid/DiffTable. R8's density argument is about SCALE: with a handful of items, per-item actions and reading beat column density. Two live precedents: the DS ForReview queue (approve / request changes on each card) and a real risk board. At cardinality many, R8 alone applies and cards fail again.
- R9 Entry points are tiles: Card/LinkTile/PlanCard or ListItem. A hub's items are destinations, not records: a tile per destination with what is waiting inside it (SAP Fiori overview page; LinkTile exists for exactly this).

Hard limits:

- H1: never table when {"cardinality":"unbounded"} — Table renders a known number of rows; an unbounded set is DataGrid, which virtualizes (AGENTS.md: choosing between neighbours). Use grid.
- H2: never cards/list when {"editable":true} — Editing as the primary task across a collection needs cells, not a dialog behind every card (Smart Interface Design Patterns). Use grid.

## Components

One line each: name, atomic level[/surface], +parts of a compound, what it is
for. Import from '@ds/<Name>' in an app, '@/components/<Name>' inside the
design system.

- Accordion · molecule · Disclosure list: a stack of headers that each reveal a panel.
- ActionCard · organism/region · A question put to THIS reader, answered on the spot: the ask, the context it needs, the answers,…
- Alert · molecule/region · Inline message on a region: `tone` carries the meaning and `onDismiss` makes it dismissible.
- AppLayout · organism/page · The application shell: navigation and a scrolling main, in one of four arrangements.
- Avatar · atom · A person or a team as an image with an initial fallback.
- AvatarGroup · molecule · Overlapping stack of avatars with a "+N" overflow — a team, the people on a thread.
- Badge · atom · Status chip: a small standalone pill that labels state through `tone`.
- BarChart · atom · A value per category, as bars: the analytical card's second form after <Sparkline> (a value over…
- BatchActions · molecule/region · The bar that appears once rows are selected: the count, what can be done to them, and the way out.
- BrandMark · molecule/region · The brand mark in its cap: a filled circle the size of a rail item, with the mark inside it…
- Breadcrumb · molecule · The trail back up a record hierarchy, e.g.
- Button · atom · The action control: `variant` sets its weight, `loading` swaps the icon for a spinner and disables…
- ButtonGroup · molecule · Two or three buttons that are one decision: "Save" beside the menu of other ways to save.
- Calendar · molecule/region · A month grid for picking a single date.
- Card · organism/region · +CardHeader,CardTitle,CardCorner,CardMeta,CardMedia · The surface a block of content sits on.
- CardStack · organism/region · Many cards of one kind, shown as one: the top card, the count, and a way into the pile.
- Carousel · organism/region · A slideshow that scrolls rather than animates.
- CellStack · atom · Two facts in one cell, stacked: a title over its path, an invoice over its supplier, a product…
- CharacterCount · atom · The remaining budget of a limited field, stated under it: instant on screen, announced only once…
- ChatComposer · molecule/region · Rounded chat input bar: auto-growing textarea plus voice/send.
- ChatMessage · molecule/region · One chat message: a right-aligned bubble for the user, a left block for the assistant with a…
- ChatShell · organism/region · Shared chrome for chat screens: full-height column → padded region → one rounded card surface that…
- Checkbox · atom · +CheckboxGroup · Custom checkbox: a real <input> (kept accessible + form-native) visually replaced by a themed box.
- Chip · atom · Rounded selectable label.
- Code · atom/region · Source code, inline in a sentence or as a block that scrolls inside itself and can be reached by…
- CodeInput · molecule · One box per character, for a verification code.
- ColorSwatch · atom · A colour as a control: the value, its name, and a pressed state.
- ColumnPicker · molecule/region · Which columns a table shows, and in what order.
- Combobox · molecule · Searchable select — the ARIA combobox pattern (input + listbox), for when a plain <Select> has too…
- CommandPalette · organism/region · The Cmd+K command palette: a centered search over an action list.
- ComparisonTable · organism/region · A few subjects as COLUMNS and their attributes as rows: plans, vendors, candidates, options.
- ConditionalReveal · molecule · The dependent field under an option: present only while that option is chosen, indented under it…
- ContentCard · organism/region · One CONTENT entry: media, eyebrow, title, excerpt, meta, actions — the six slots every feed…
- ContentSidePanel · organism/region · Document side panel: an icon rail that slides a SidePanel out over the content, one panel per icon.
- ContextMenu · molecule/region · A right-click menu positioned at the pointer.
- CopyButton · molecule · Copy a value, and say so.
- CountBadge · molecule · A count or dot pinned to the top-inline-end corner of whatever it wraps — notifications on a bell,…
- DataGrid · organism/region · A virtualized table: only the rows in view (plus a small overscan) are in the DOM, so tens of…
- DateBlock · atom · A date as a block the eye lands on first: the month small over the day large.
- DatePicker · molecule · A date field: a trigger that reads like an input and opens a <Calendar> in a <Popover>.
- DateRangePicker · molecule · A date-span field: one trigger, one <Calendar>, two picks.
- Descriptions · molecule · A read-only list of field/value pairs — a record's metadata, a summary panel.
- DiffTable · organism/region · What changed, side by side: an audit trail, a review of an edit, a settings history.
- Divider · atom · The one hairline separator.
- DonutChart · atom · A whole split into named shares: how much of the total is open, at risk, done.
- Dropdown · molecule/region · +DropdownItem,DropdownSection,DropdownDivider · Menu hung on a trigger you supply: keyboard navigation, portal and ARIA are built in, so spread…
- EmptyState · molecule/region · What a screen shows when it has nothing: an icon, a sentence about why it is empty, and the action…
- EntityLink · molecule · One entity that lives ELSEWHERE, shown with enough of itself to be recognised: inline inside a…
- ErrorSummary · molecule/region · The on-submit list of what the form rejected: focusable, counted, and each row links to its own…
- ExpandButton · atom · The chevron that opens and closes a row or a panel, with the rotation and the aria-expanded wiring…
- FeedbackModal · organism/region · "What went wrong?" — negative-feedback dialog (matches the original).
- Field · molecule · Form field: a label (with optional required marker), the hint or error, then its control, wired…
- FileUpload · molecule · A drop area plus a native file picker, with a removable list of attached files.
- FilterBar · organism/region · The row of filters above a list: FilterDropdowns side by side on desktop, one icon that opens them…

- FormStack · molecule · Vertical stack of Fields inside a modal or panel.
- Highlight · atom · Marks the matched part of a result, so a list of hits shows WHY each one is a hit.
- HoverCard · molecule/region · Hover-triggered rich card — a profile preview on a name, a definition on a term.
- Icon · atom · Every icon in the system, addressed by Material-style name.
- IconButton · atom · A button whose label is an icon, which is why it always takes an aria-label and a Tooltip.
- IconDisc · atom · An icon in a filled disc, at a proportion nobody has to choose.
- Identity · molecule · A person as one glance: avatar beside name and secondary line — the face next to the name, never a…
- InlineText · molecule · True inline editing (the vanilla `.editable` contract): the SAME element becomes editable on click…
- Input · atom · The single-line text field: label, invalid state and the shared control tokens.
- InputGroup · molecule · A field with something attached to it: `https://` before the value, `kg` after it, a Copy button…
- Kbd · atom · One key as a key cap, with real <kbd> semantics: the shortcut hint next to a CommandPalette…
- Label · atom · The text that names a control and is tied to it by htmlFor.
- Layout · atom · +GridItem,Row,Stack · Layout primitives: Stack and Row for gaps in one direction, Grid for a set of cards — auto-fitting…
- LineChart · atom · A value over time, as a line: the analytical card's first form when the question is "which way is…
- Link · atom · A link: text that goes somewhere.
- LinkTile · organism/region · A clickable tile: navigates on click/Enter/Space, with an overflow (⋮) menu in its top-inline-end…
- ListCluster · organism · Centered "welcome" list: big title + subtitle, the tile grid, a large CTA under the cards.
- ListItem · molecule · One clickable row of a list: an optional marker, leading media, title, meta and a trailing action,…
- LoadMore · molecule/region · The end of a list that has more of it.
- LogoWall · molecule/region · Customer or partner marks in ONE optical weight: unlike logos are drawn at unlike strengths, and a…
- MenuButton · molecule · A button that opens a MENU, in its two forms: one target that opens the menu, or — with `onClick`…

- NumberInput · molecule · A number field with stepper buttons.
- PageHeader · organism/region · The top of a page: title, breadcrumb and the page-level actions.
- Pagination · molecule · Pager for a known total: renders nothing for a single page and collapses long ranges with gaps.
- PasswordInput · molecule · A password field that can be read back.
- PivotTable · organism/region · Two categorical axes and one measure in the cell: teams by month, region by product, skill by level.
- PlanCard · organism/region · One plan in a pricing row: what it is called, what it costs, what it includes and the single…
- Popover · molecule/region · Click-triggered floating panel for RICH content: a form, a group of controls, a detail card.
- Progress · atom · How far along something is — as a bar or as a ring.
- Prose · atom/region · A sentence, at a measure.
- Quote · molecule · A quotation with its attribution, in real <figure>/<blockquote> semantics — a testimonial, a…
- Radio · atom · +RadioGroup · Single custom radio, one option in a set where exactly one is chosen.

- Rating · molecule · A star rating, a score out of `max` stars.

- SaveStatus · atom · Whether the work is safe right now: saving, saved at a time, or failed.

- Stepper · molecule/region · Progress across an ordered set of steps (a wizard, a multi-step form).
- Switch · atom · An on/off setting that applies the moment it is flipped (role="switch").
- Table · organism/region · +TableScroll,THead,TBody,TFoot,Tr,Th,Td,ThGroup,TrGroup,TdExpand,TrDetail,TableEmpty,TableSkeleton · A styled, accessible table.

- Tooltip · molecule/region · Text on hover and focus, and the only right answer for naming an icon-only control.
- Tree · molecule/region · Hierarchical expand/collapse list (files, categories).

## Blocks (page-level compositions)

Import from '@blocks/<Name>' in an app, '@/blocks/<Name>' inside the system.

- AdaptiveListPage · block/page · A list page that changes shape with its contents: a centred welcome (hero title, the cards, one…
- AuthTemplate · block/page · Centered auth-page skeleton: one Card with a brand slot, the caller's content, an error slot, and…
- DetailPageTemplate · block/page · The DETAIL page skeleton: a header with back + actions, then a main content column and an optional…
- FormPageTemplate · block/page · The page-sized FORM skeleton: a capped column of `<FormSection>`s under the page header, the error…
- FormPanel · block/region · A form in a SIDE PANEL: the same contract as a form in a `<Modal>` for the case a dialog gets…
- ListPageTemplate · block/page · The LIST page skeleton, the most common product screen: a header (title + actions), an optional…
- OverviewPageTemplate · block/page · +OverviewWidget · The OVERVIEW page skeleton, read at a glance and acted on elsewhere: header (freshness lives in…
- Page · block/page · The PAGE mechanism: the regions a screen is made of and the shape its body takes.
- RenameDialog · block/region · Give one thing a new name: a dialog with a single field, Enter to save; an empty name cannot…
- SettingsPageTemplate · block/page · +SettingsSection,SettingRow · The SETTINGS page skeleton: a deliberately narrow column of sections, each a Card of explained rows.
- SystemPageTemplate · block/page · The SYSTEM page skeleton — not found, service unavailable, something broke: a narrow centred…
- WizardTemplate · block/page · +WizardReview,WizardReviewRow · The WIZARD page skeleton: a Stepper over one step at a time, Back/Next below, the last step…

## Deeper contracts

- component-registry.json: every prop, union and golden example, machine-readable.
- screen-specs/selection-rules.json: the full decision rules with right/wrong pairs.
- tokens/design.tokens.json: the token set in DTCG format.
- mcp/server.mjs: the same answers as MCP tools (index, component, tokens, decide, verify).
